subject.title: [Feature]: Add X-Actual-Model header to expose runtime model in HTTP responses

question: What public Gateway contract should expose the actual runtime model for non-streaming and streaming OpenAI-compatible responses?
rationale: This is a public API/product choice because ordinary response headers cannot cover late streaming fallback selection, while changing the response `model` field could conflict with the documented agent-target model contract.

options.title: Add streaming-safe metadata contract
options.body: Define an additive response-body/SSE metadata surface, with a header only where it is reliable, while preserving the current agent-target `model` field semantics.

options.title: Header-only narrow contract
options.body: Expose a header for non-streaming or pre-selected cases and document that streaming fallback identity may be unavailable or separate.

options.title: Fold into broader observability work
options.body: Move the remaining transport decision under the broader resolved-model/session observability effort and keep this issue as the HTTP-specific acceptance criterion.

recommendation.title: Add streaming-safe metadata contract
recommendation.body: Define an additive response-body/SSE metadata surface, with a header only where it is reliable, while preserving the current agent-target `model` field semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest sampled history on the Gateway HTTP contract and related maintainer review context for this issue.
